skills: Hold: a guard stance for up to 1.5s; getting hit parries for massive Daze and gives 1 Sugar Point.
With Sugar Points, when another Agent lands a hit, she spins her umbrella around the target and fires a shell for Physical DMG (1 Sugar Point on the heavy hit). Aftershock; once per 8s.
Hits Sweet Scare enemies once per second for Physical DMG (or the Flavor Match attribute), with higher Anomaly Buildup that doesn't count toward Anomaly DMG.
A stronger Sparkles when Hard Candy Shot or Stuffed Hard Candy Shot's heavy hit lands on a Sweet Scare enemy.
Off-field, her tanuki Kama joins the on-field Agent's attacks for Physical DMG (also during Tanuki Cloak). Uses her initial ATK.
Parries for massive Daze; +1 Sugar Point.
Press on time after a Defensive Assist or Tanuki Cloak parry: umbrella spin and a powerful shell for Physical DMG.
Bomb throw for Physical DMG; the heavy hit applies Sweet Scare. +2 Sugar Points; triggers a Quick Assist on hit. Has a faster version, Cavity Alert, Right Now!
A timed debuff. The first hit from an on-field Agent using their attribute sets Flavor Match, switching Sparkles on that enemy to that attribute; reapplying Sweet Scare resets it.
Powerful strike for massive Physical DMG; +1 Sugar Point. Triggers a Quick Assist on hit.
Wide strike for massive Physical DMG that applies Sweet Scare; others gain Energy, +2 Sugar Points. Triggers a Quick Assist on hit.

core.name: Whimsical Wonder
core.text: Enters battle with 3 Sugar Points (max 6). Her EX Specials and Ultimate give the squad Tanuki Wish for 40s: ATK equal to 40% of her initial ATK (max {0}, reached at {1} initial ATK) and +15% DMG.

ability.name: The More the Merrier
ability.text: Each point of Anomaly Mastery above 100 gives Tanuki Wish holders +0.2% Anomaly Buildup Rate and +0.2% Attribute Anomaly and Disorder DMG (max 20% each, at 200).

mindscapes: Enters battle with 30 Energy (once per 180s in Investigation Zones). Sweet Scare enemies lose 10% All-Attribute RES. Her Additional Ability's Anomaly and Disorder bonus is 130% as strong.

Her EX and Ultimate hits give the squad +15% DMG and Anomaly Buildup Rate for 40s; their heavy hit on a non-Stunned enemy forces a lower-Interrupt Chain Attack (once per 20s). Chain switch-ins give 1 Sugar Point. Hard Candy Shot cooldown -25%.
Both Assist Follow-Ups deal +30% DMG and +20% Anomaly Buildup, and trigger a Quick Assist on hit.

Parries give 1 more Sugar Point. Stuffed Hard Candy Shot can charge 0.8s: one extra shell, plus one per 0.4s charged for 1 Sugar Point each (300% ATK). Shell hits give the squad +105% Disorder DMG multiplier (max 3, 40s each) and trigger Sparkles - Max on Sweet Scare enemies. Getting hit while charging dodges and fires at full charge.
